B. Hydrolysis of an acetal is catalyzed by acids. This statement is correct as acid catalysis is required to revert acetals back to their carbonyl and alcohol components.

C. Hydrolysis of an acetal is catalyzed by bases. This statement is incorrect because acetal hydrolysis does not occur under basic conditions; it requires an acidic environment.
